# Art credits

All third-party art in the DAWG Arcade is released under **CC0 (public domain)**. Credit is not
required, but these creators deserve it. Everything else (the DAWGs, games, posters, UI and
sounds) is original to the DAWG Arcade.

| What | Where it's used | Creator | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Car Kit 3.1: karts and street vehicles (`models/cars/`) | Drift Dawgs karts, DAWG Cross traffic | Kenney | https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit | CC0 |
| Racing Kit: barriers, light posts, grandstand, gantry, flags, billboard (`models/racing/`) | Drift Dawgs track side | Kenney | https://kenney.nl/assets/racing-kit | CC0 |
| City Kit (Commercial) 2.1: buildings (`models/city/`) | City scenery | Kenney | https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-commercial | CC0 |
| City Kit (Roads): roads and street props (`models/roads/`) | Street scenery | Kenney | https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-roads | CC0 |
| Shanghai Bund HDRI, 1k (`env/shanghai_bund_1k.hdr`) | Reflections and lighting in the 3D games | Greg Zaal, Poly Haven | https://polyhaven.com/a/shanghai_bund | CC0 |

Each `models/*/LICENSE.txt` is the license file shipped with that kit.
